name: radar_fields_b7873200_production_v1

schedule.interpretation: The 8000-step schedule is the proposed production clock. The one-update smoke compressed both schedules and is not a production prefix.

objective.target_construction: coherent frequency response -> IFFT over frequency -> squared magnitude range power -> train-only normalized dB intensity
objective.unsupported_roi_cells: retained in the native FFT L1 objective after zero RCS rendering

resources.headroom_gate: process RSS and Torch allocated GPU memory remain below 80 percent of reserved capacity
resources.sizing_basis: The one-update gate measured 2.3 seconds for the update and 45 seconds end-to-end on RTX6000; the 12-hour allocation is a conservative proposal, not a measured full-run guarantee.

regions.whole_roi: all scene-range-mask entries, including unsupported/padded cells
regions.valid_region: entries where differentiable range-cell interpolation mass is positive

readout.zero_reference: zero RCS passed through the same released native intensity transform; with offset=0.05 and scaler=1 this is log10(0.05) = -1.3010299957 before comparison to the normalized target

evidence_limits: The real-update gate proves the sealed full-pair path and one native optimizer update, not convergence.
The ROI diagnostic measures a reported-loss floor and zero padded-cell parameter gradients; it does not justify changing the objective.

review_decisions: Approve or revise the proposed 8000-update production clock and 12-hour RTX6000 envelope.
Confirm that whole-ROI and valid-region normalized-dB intensity errors, each paired with the zero-RCS reference, are the required native readout.
Keep production_clearance=false until actual scientific evidence exists; review authorization alone is not a numerical or performance pass.
